# WhoUnfollowed

> Privacy-first Instagram follower analysis. Upload the data export Instagram gives you and see who doesn't follow you back, who unfollowed you, and how your audience changes over time. Everything is processed in your browser. No password, no server, no Instagram API.

WhoUnfollowed reads the official "Download Your Information" ZIP that Instagram provides under GDPR Article 20. The parsing engine is open source under MPL-2.0, so anyone can verify what happens to their data. The free tier runs entirely client-side and needs no account. Pro adds encrypted cloud snapshot history, comparison over time, follower charts, and email alerts when a new export reveals unfollowers.

## Key facts
- No Instagram password is ever required. The tool reads a data export the user already owns.
- The free tier processes data entirely in the browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
- TOS-compliant: it does not use the Instagram API and does not scrape Instagram.
- Open core: the parser is public and MPL-2.0 licensed.
